commands_run: clan patch-data doc.clan '{...}' --agent creative-director --action 'agency brief: SMP and budget locked'
clan pack-html doc.clan /tmp/agency-brief.html --output doc.clan --assets /tmp/agency-assets --delta 'hop 1: agency brief with brand mark asset'
errors: pack-html does not accept --agent/--action flags; attribution embedded via YAML frontmatter in HTML instead
pack-html --assets expects a directory path, not a file path; copied SVG to temp dir before passing
problems_and_friction: Two friction points: (1) pack-html has no --agent/--action flags unlike patch-data — attribution must go in HTML frontmatter. (2) --assets flag requires a directory, not a file path — the help text says 'directory containing binary/text assets' but the task specified a file path directly.
context_understood: Three-hop brand refresh workflow for Brightline Logistics. Hop 1 locked SMP ('Move faster, trust every mile'), budget (EUR 85000), persona, tone, and theme ('Precision in Motion'). SVG brand mark packed as human/assets/logo-mark.svg inside the .clan archive. Agency brief HTML view templated with clan-asset: reference resolved at render time.
